title: Context optimization and memory budgets
subtitle: Measure, select, compress, and cache context without losing critical evidence.
goal: Use a limited window without losing the facts that matter
intro: Optimization should preserve task quality, not merely reduce token count.
terms: Conditions under which reused material remains correct
case: A support conversation grows beyond the available context window.
A compact checkpoint preserves current intent and completed operation IDs.
